description: 豪杰成长计划plus 图片素材目录。binding 对应已接入的界面地点和人物；业务许可由 game/scene.json 管理。路径相对于本清单所在目录。

artDirection.setting: 明代广东的虚构人生游戏
artDirection.style: 淡彩水墨与细腻手绘；暖米白、青灰、木色、靛蓝
artDirection.backgrounds: 固定横向场景，无人物、界面或名称文字
artDirection.portraits: 独立方形半身像，米白底，用于头像卡片和对话面板
artDirection.items: 可复用物品图，书名与品质由界面展示

referenceSources.usage: 仅作窦苞外形参考；参考原图不随项目分发，运行时使用生成画像。

source.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create one finished landscape background asset for a Chinese Ming-era narrative life-simulation game, Guangdong in the mid-1500s. Scene: the welcoming courtyard of a modest but comfortable landholding family's home, not a palace. Whitewashed and soft grey walls, weathered dark tiled roofs, timber doors, a stone path, two terracotta plant pots, a little bamboo, glimpses of a quiet study through an open side door. No people. Art direction: refined hand-painted 2D storybook environment, delicate ink contours and matte watercolor/gouache color, believable architecture and perspective, warm rice-paper cream, muted jade green and warm wood brown, gentle afternoon light, understated and calm, richly finished rather than a sketch. Landscape 16:9 composition for a full-screen fixed game background, eye-level wide shot; keep visual details mainly in middle and lower zones, low contrast in top left and right to allow UI overlays; readable when slightly darkened. No interface, no text, no signboards with writing, no calligraphy, no watermark, no modern objects, no people baked into the scene. Single cohesive image, not a grid or contact sheet.

Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE standalone finished game background. The supplied image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its hand-painted ink-and-gouache finish, natural perspective, warm cream plaster, muted jade, aged dark wood, detailed but calm Ming Guangdong environment. Do not copy its courtyard composition. New scene: Interior of a modest Ming Chinese elementary private school lecture room, empty short rows of individual wooden study desks and stools, a larger teacher's lectern and brush rest, softly lit timber lattice windows, clay plaster walls, a few closed thread-bound books. It must feel suitable for young beginners taught by a female tutor, not an imperial academy. No blackboard, no classroom posters, no people. Landscape 16:9, eye-level wide shot, fixed background for a text-driven game. Keep corners low-contrast enough for overlays, focus detail in the middle/lower field. Architectural coherence and readable interiors. No people baked into backgrounds, no UI, no writing, no watermarks, no collage. Entire image should be this one scene.

Use case: character-design-reference-edit. Create ONE finished square NPC half-body portrait for a Ming-era Chinese life-simulation game.
Reference image 1 is the requested Doubao character appearance: preserve its most recognizable visual identity — sleek chin-length very dark brown bob, side-parted curved fringe, large warm dark eyes, rounded friendly face, gentle closed-mouth smile. She is an adult female schoolteacher named Dou Bao (窦苞); make her clearly a young adult, not a child.
Reference image 2 is the game's rendering and color style, ONLY: soft ink-and-gouache illustration, warm ivory paper, muted jade and natural cloth colors, subtly hand-painted texture.
Change the modern black buttoned T-shirt to a restrained Ming-inspired female teacher outfit: pale jade green cross-collar upper robe closing to her right with an ivory inner collar, generous but practical long sleeves, a glimpse of an unpatterned cream skirt and a simple cloth sash. No palace jewelry, no imperial/court insignia, no fantasy armor. Her recognizable short bob stays short; do not replace it with a long-haired bun.
Three-quarter view from waist up; hold one closed indigo thread-bound book with a blank paper label neatly in both hands. Calm, approachable, a hint of wit, competent educator. Balance the appealing stylized face of reference 1 with the painted finish of reference 2. Plain warm ivory background, subtle pale circular watercolor wash, generous safe margins for an avatar crop. No lettering, no logos, no watermark, no interface, no collage, no extra people. Entire final image is this one portrait.

Use case: character-design. Create ONE finished standalone game asset.
Reference 1 is the game environment art style, not the composition. Reference 2 is the approved teacher portrait, for the SAME painted finish and stylized adult character design language only. Do not copy her face or bob haircut.
Art direction: refined ink-and-gouache, soft warm ivory paper texture, muted jade, indigo and warm wood colors; gentle convincing light, understated historical costume and materials, no photorealistic rendering.
Subject: Original fictional NPC Shen Yan, an adult Chinese MAN who looks after a small private school's books in mid-1500s Ming Guangdong. Gentle, observant and scholarly face, a little older-looking than the female tutor, dark hair gathered under a simple cloth scholar cap, no extravagant official hat, understated dark slate-blue crossed-collar robe with tan accents. Half-body portrait holding a tied bundle of thread-bound books with natural hands, kind reserved expression. This is an ordinary book keeper, not a mandarin official or warrior. Square composition, centered face and upper body, complete head with generous margins, plain warm ivory painted background suitable for a character panel.
No text, no name labels, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no collage. Entire image is the one requested portrait.
